configuration: Radial-basis orthonormality; float64 output, SAB_REPEATS=1, fixed deterministic geometry, and the parameters documented in runner.py.
observable: GTO alpha/beta arrays and numerically integrated radial overlap matrices through l=20.
default_vs_upstream: Adapted from the corresponding official test into a self-contained deterministic numerical observable; breadth is retained while redundant parametrizations are reduced.
variant: ic/variant changes one active binary64 input value from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two ulps); the value perturbs a coordinate or, for radial orthonormality, r_cut.
altbuild: none: the initial Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; cross-build numerical floors will be represented by calibration evidence when available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; the Docker nominal/variant calibration measured a 5.912e-12 spread.

warrant: GTO alpha/beta parameters and overlap matrices are compared pointwise at atol=1e-8 and rtol=1e-6; direct reference comparison permits a stricter bound than the upstream identity-residual assertion. The measured Docker perturbation spread is 5.912e-12; a 0.1 single-entry fault was rejected, and overlap or inverse-square-root normalization faults exceed the approved bound.
